verdict.rationale: Osborne Clarke's EC&VC page offers free downloadable cap table templates (UK and DE versions) and a free online investor-readiness tool, so the firm does publish some public startup resources. None of the story's named documents (incorporation documents, SAFEs/term sheets, NDAs) is offered as a free generator or download; term sheets appear only as advisory services for clients. Missing for 10: free incorporation document templates, SAFE/term sheet templates or generators, NDA templates, explicit confirmation of access without client engagement, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can use the firm's free public document generators or downloadable startup forms — incorporation documents, SAFEs/term sheets, NDAs — without being a client

citations.quote: free downloadable "Cap table (UK version)" and "Cap table (DE version)"
